name: Shipping and Handling
summary: Your employer asks you to carry a crate to Steamwheedle Port. A goblin there is expected to pay his dues.

sections.title: A Crate to Deliver
sections.body: Your employer is busy negotiating in town, so he gives you a crate for his associate. He expects you to take a ship from the docks to Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris. There, Wharfmaster Steamfizzle is the one to speak with, and a goblin's dues are at stake.

faq.answer: Your employer gives you the crate while he handles negotiations in town.
The crate is meant for your employer's associate at Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.

faq.q: Who do I speak with at Steamwheedle Port?
faq.answer: At Steamwheedle Port, the named contact is Wharfmaster Steamfizzle.

faq.q: Why am I carrying a crate?
faq.answer: Your employer asks you to deliver the crate because he is busy negotiating in town.

faq.q: What is the goblin supposed to do?
faq.answer: Your employer expects a goblin at Steamwheedle Port to pay his dues.
